q-nt-1-3-lean.statement: ∀ a b c x y : Int, a ∣ b → a ∣ c → a ∣ b * x + c * y
q-nt-1-3-lean.proof:
theorem answer : ∀ a b c x y : Int, a ∣ b → a ∣ c → a ∣ b * x + c * y := by
  intro a b c x y hb hc
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hc
  exact ⟨k * x + l * y, by grind⟩

q-nt-12-3-lean.statement: ∀ a b c d m : Int, a % m = b % m → c % m = d % m → a * c % m = b * d % m
q-nt-12-3-lean.proof:
theorem answer : ∀ a b c d m : Int, a % m = b % m → c % m = d % m → a * c % m = b * d % m := by
  intro a b c d m h1 h2
  rw [Int.mul_emod, h1, h2, ← Int.mul_emod]

q-nt-3-3-lean.statement: ∀ a b : Nat, b ≤ a → Nat.gcd (a - b) b = Nat.gcd a b
q-nt-3-3-lean.proof:
theorem answer : ∀ a b : Nat, b ≤ a → Nat.gcd (a - b) b = Nat.gcd a b := by
  intro a b h
  rw [Nat.gcd_comm (a - b) b, Nat.gcd_comm a b]
  have : a = (a - b) + b := by omega
  conv => rhs; rw [this]
  simp

q-ialg-11-3-lean.statement: ∀ n : Nat, 6 * ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun k => k ^ 2)).sum = n * (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1)
q-ialg-11-3-lean.proof:
theorem answer : ∀ n : Nat, 6 * ((List.range (n + 1)).map (fun k => k ^ 2)).sum = n * (n + 1) * (2 * n + 1) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
    grind

q-icp-8-2-lean.statement: ∀ n : Nat, ((List.range n).map (fun k => 2 * k + 1)).sum = n ^ 2
q-icp-8-2-lean.proof:
theorem answer : ∀ n : Nat, ((List.range n).map (fun k => 2 * k + 1)).sum = n ^ 2 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.sum_append, ih]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
    grind

q-zeitz-2-3-lean.proof:
theorem answer : ∀ n : Nat, 5 ≤ n → n ^ 2 < 2 ^ n := by
  intro n h
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hk : 5 ≤ k
    · have step := ih hk
      have grow : 2 * k + 1 ≤ k * k := by
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right k hk
        omega
      have e1 : (k + 1) ^ 2 = k * k + 2 * k + 1 := by grind
      have e2 : 2 ^ (k + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ k := by rw [Nat.pow_succ]; omega
      rw [Nat.pow_two] at step
      rw [e1, e2]
      generalize k * k = s at *
      generalize 2 ^ k = t at *
      omega
    · have : k = 4 := by omega
      subst this
      decide

q-alg-21-4-lean.statement: ∀ (a r : Int) (n : Nat), (r - 1) * ((List.range n).map (fun k => a * r ^ k)).sum = a * (r ^ n - 1)
q-alg-21-4-lean.proof:
theorem answer : ∀ (a r : Int) (n : Nat), (r - 1) * ((List.range n).map (fun k => a * r ^ k)).sum = a * (r ^ n - 1) := by
  intro a r n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
    rw [Int.mul_add, ih, Int.pow_succ]
    grind
